entities.summary: Wars fought between ancient rome (including both the roman kingdom and the roman republic) and the latins, from the earliest stages of the history of rome until the final subjugation of the latins to rome in the aftermath of the latin war Took place in Latium. Date: 340 BCE. Ended: 337 BCE.
